steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0, boundary: state.boundary };

steps.send: I take the brass key from the hook.

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin The brass key is cold in your hand.

extract.debugResponse:
DELTA q=took_key value=true evidence="I take the brass key"
FACT importance=2 text="The player carries the brass key." evidence="I take the brass key from the hook."

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const chat = ctx.chat; if (chat.length !== 2 || !chat[0].is_user || chat[1].is_user || chat[1].name !== 'Arin') throw new Error(`expected [player line, Arin reply], got ${JSON.stringify(chat.map((m) => [m.name, m.is_user, m.mes]))}`); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId !== 1 || state.blackboard.values.took_key !== true) throw new Error(`the reply was not consumed with took_key: last=${state.lastMessageId} values=${JSON.stringify(state.blackboard.values)}`); const reply = chat[1]; reply.swipes = ['An earlier take on the key.', 'A second take on the key.', reply.mes]; reply.swipe_id = 2; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipes: reply.swipes.length, swipe_id: reply.swipe_id, mes: reply.mes };

const { deleteSwipe } = await import('/script.js'); const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; const before = { mes: chat[1].mes, swipe_id: chat[1].swipe_id }; const next = await deleteSwipe(0, 1); const after = { mes: chat[1].mes, swipe_id: chat[1].swipe_id, swipes: chat[1].swipes.length }; if (after.swipe_id !== 1 || after.mes !== before.mes || after.swipes !== 2) throw new Error(`deleteSwipe did not take the H7 shape (swipe_id 2 -> 1, mes unchanged): before ${JSON.stringify(before)} after ${JSON.stringify(after)}`); return { returned: next ?? null, before, after };
